【升級？就係唔使密碼同簽名都認證到！⭕️】 日常生活咁多密碼簽名要記著，一時三刻未必諗得起或簽得啱🧐？收到你👌🏻！而家打開HSBC HK App，就可以幫你輕鬆認證身分🤩，代替簽名同密碼！ 無論落分行定電話理財，你都一樣可以用手機認證*，指紋又得☝️、Face ID都得👁️，理財體驗就係咁貼心。 HSBC HK App仲有好多升級咗嘅新功能㗎📱，快啲了解更多啦！https://grp.hsbc/NSIAAIGTC *滙豐流動理財認證服務只限指定銀行服務。 屏幕顯示僅供參考及說明用途。 #滙豐 #流動理財應用程式 #手機認證 【We’ve made it better: Authentication without passcode or signature⭕️】 Having trouble remembering your account passcode and signature🧐? We've got you👌🏻! Now, you can authenticate on your HSBC HK App too🤩! It’s banking made simpler: whether you’re banking over the phone or at our branches, you can authenticate effortlessly in our app using your fingerprint☝️or Face ID*👁. There are so many features that we’ve made better on the HSBC HK App📱Click the link to learn more: https://grp.hsbc/NSIAAIGEN *The HSBC HK App authentication is limited to designated banking services. The screen displays are for reference and illustration purposes only. #HSBC #HSBCHKApp #InAppAuthentication
